Generated from source. Run `npm run code-map:check` before relying on line links. Read [the change guide](CODE_GUIDE.md) for behavior and boundaries.

## App entry and presentation

The activity hosts Compose; root state selects onboarding or the authenticated shell. Screen state and user actions are coordinated by the main view model.

- [MainActivity](../apps/android/app/src/main/java/de/lunara/app/MainActivity.kt#L29) — Android entry point and app lifecycle
- [LunaraApp](../apps/android/app/src/main/java/de/lunara/app/ui/LunaraApp.kt#L19) — Root UI and account navigation
- [MainShell](../apps/android/app/src/main/java/de/lunara/app/ui/main/MainShell.kt#L187) — Today, calendar, history/support and settings
- [MainViewModel](../apps/android/app/src/main/java/de/lunara/app/ui/main/MainViewModel.kt#L164) — Screen state, scoped refreshes and user actions
- [LunaraTheme](../apps/android/app/src/main/java/de/lunara/app/ui/theme/LunaraTheme.kt#L123) — Color roles, typography and component shape system

## Login and persistent renewal

Authentik's browser flow uses PKCE. Its gateway token and Lunara's own app session are separate credentials; both must renew without confusing temporary network faults with revoked access.

- [AuthentikAuthManager](../apps/android/app/src/main/java/de/lunara/app/security/AuthentikAuthManager.kt#L52) — PKCE browser login, provider token refresh and scoped persistence
- [DurableSessionRenewal](../apps/android/app/src/main/java/de/lunara/app/security/DurableSessionRenewal.kt#L21) — Serialized, cancellation-safe renewal through durable commit
- [SessionSecrets](../apps/android/app/src/main/java/de/lunara/app/data/repository/SessionSecrets.kt#L12) — Encrypted credentials, atomic provider state and account generation checks
- [refresh](../apps/android/app/src/main/java/de/lunara/app/data/repository/ConnectionRepository.kt#L591) — Inner Lunara session rotation and failure classification
- [ApiClientFactory](../apps/android/app/src/main/java/de/lunara/app/data/remote/ApiClientFactory.kt#L146) — Origin-bound gateway and app authorization headers
- [refresh](../services/api/src/auth/auth.service.ts#L404) — Server rotation, same-family proof, expiry, replay recovery and revocation
- [OidcTokenVerifier](../services/api/src/auth/oidc-token-verifier.ts#L160) — Signed external identity verification and provider outage classification

## Offline data, synchronization and logout

Room/SQLCipher retains scoped local data and queued edits. WorkManager coordinates retries; server changes and logout must not allow old requests to restore another session.

- [LunaraDatabase](../apps/android/app/src/main/java/de/lunara/app/data/local/LunaraDatabase.kt#L20) — Encrypted local schema and migrations
- [PeriodRepository](../apps/android/app/src/main/java/de/lunara/app/data/repository/PeriodRepository.kt#L28) — Local journal writes and queued mutations
- [SyncWorker](../apps/android/app/src/main/java/de/lunara/app/data/sync/SyncWorker.kt#L44) — Bounded upload/download batches and retry policy
- [SyncScheduler](../apps/android/app/src/main/java/de/lunara/app/data/sync/SyncScheduler.kt#L20) — Immediate, manual and periodic background work
- [eraseLocalAccount](../apps/android/app/src/main/java/de/lunara/app/data/repository/AccountRepository.kt#L19) — Explicit logout and local-account cleanup coordination

## Recorded-period transfer

Date-only CSV and JSON transfer is tracker-owned. File parsing precedes an explicit preview and confirmation; duplicate records are skipped, conflicting ranges reject the batch, and an account change invalidates pending file operations. Android persists the import atomically with its sync queue; the web uses its encrypted local vault or the authenticated server import.

- [PeriodExportFormat](../apps/android/app/src/main/java/de/lunara/app/data/repository/PeriodExportFormat.kt#L51) — Bounded date-only formats, validation and import planning
- [PeriodExportRepository](../apps/android/app/src/main/java/de/lunara/app/data/repository/PeriodExportRepository.kt#L27) — SAF input/output and owner-bound snapshots
- [parsePeriodFile](../apps/web/src/period-transfer.ts#L144) — Browser CSV/JSON compatibility and validation
- [LunaraApi](../apps/web/src/api.ts#L35) — Authenticated server import and generation-bound retries
- [DataManagementService](../services/api/src/data-management/data-management.service.ts#L69) — Server export and atomic previewed import

## Shared calendar appearance

Android supplies the visual reference. Both clients use rose for recorded days, one dashed amber category for the whole estimated period and teal for estimated fertility, with three matching symbols and legend entries. Recorded entries take precedence. The browser displays only complete, valid prediction boundaries using the same projection as Android; this does not calculate new predictions or grant access to private data.

- [CalendarColors](../apps/android/app/src/main/java/de/lunara/app/ui/theme/CalendarColors.kt#L9) — Explicit light/dark semantic colors independent of decorative branding
- [CalendarDayKind](../apps/android/app/src/main/java/de/lunara/app/ui/main/CalendarDayKind.kt#L4) — Recorded, forecast and fertility presentation priority
- [CalendarLegend](../apps/android/app/src/main/java/de/lunara/app/ui/main/MainShell.kt#L1458) — Native legend with solid and dashed category borders
- [calendarPredictionBand](../apps/web/src/calendar-presentation.ts#L12) — Native-equivalent validation of existing prediction boundaries
- [SwipeCalendar](../apps/web/src/calendar.ts#L62) — Browser calendar controls, category styling and accessible statuses
- [createCalendarLegend](../apps/web/src/calendar.ts#L49) — Matching browser legend and meaningful non-color labels

## Prediction model and current-summary freshness

API and offline engines use the same supported history and duration limits. Phase consumers use the existing prediction center and configured luteal assumption. Summary policies suppress past start windows and pending server edits without changing stored history or calendar bands; foreground midnight/resume updates are bounded. These checks prove software consistency, not clinical accuracy.

- [calculatePrediction](../services/api/src/prediction/prediction.algorithm.ts#L165) — Canonical cycle and duration model with uncertainty and eligibility
- [estimatedOvulationDay](../services/api/src/prediction/prediction.algorithm.ts#L364) — Common model center for permitted phase consumers, not a confirmed ovulation
- [LocalPredictionEngine](../apps/android/app/src/main/java/de/lunara/app/data/prediction/LocalPredictionEngine.kt#L16) — Native offline estimate
- [calculateLocalPrediction](../apps/web/src/local-prediction.ts#L33) — Browser offline estimate with matching duration selection and fallback bounds
- [PredictionFreshnessPolicy](../apps/android/app/src/main/java/de/lunara/app/ui/main/PredictionFreshnessPolicy.kt#L10) — Native summary cutoff, pending changes and timezone day boundary
- [predictionSummary](../apps/web/src/prediction-freshness.ts#L9) — Browser current-summary classification without modifying cached data

## Unconfirmed five-day period bounds

A missing end means five inclusive calendar days, retrospectively as well as for new records. The bound is derived, never saved as an observed end. Manual dates win; all overlap validators and the database constraint use the same bound. After day five, history/calendar editors still allow a manual correction. Raw-null exports, backups, sync and model statistics remain unchanged.

- [PeriodEndPolicy](../apps/android/app/src/main/java/de/lunara/app/core/model/PeriodEndPolicy.kt#L6) — Native date-only inferred bounds, active state and calendar display
- [periodEndState](../apps/web/src/period-end.ts#L20) — Browser active/assumed-complete state without writes
- [periodRangesOverlap](../apps/web/src/period-end.ts#L35) — Symmetric bounded browser import and backup validation
- [effectivePeriodEndDate](../services/api/src/periods/period-policy.ts#L12) — Canonical five-day bound for date-only database values
- [assertNoOverlap](../services/api/src/periods/periods.service.ts#L326) — Owner-scoped overlap query bounding both operands

## Partner calendar consent and availability

The server reports effective sharing permissions without disclosing whether private health records exist. Clients distinguish denied or unknown access, unavailable estimates and empty results. Forecasts remain estimates, not a contraception or ovulation confirmation.

- [projectPartnerDashboard](../services/api/src/partner/partner-projection.ts#L37) — Privacy-filtered response and effective calendar access flags
- [CalendarStatusPolicy](../apps/android/app/src/main/java/de/lunara/app/ui/main/CalendarStatusPolicy.kt#L24) — Native calendar notices and read-only sharing status
- [visiblePartnerCalendar](../apps/web/src/partner-calendar.ts#L5) — Consent-aware browser calendar projection
- [hasFertileEstimate](../apps/web/src/fertility-presentation.ts#L5) — Bound historical fertility envelopes independently of other prediction permissions
- [hasCurrentFertileEstimate](../apps/web/src/fertility-presentation.ts#L20) — Expire current fertility summaries at their own end and during pending edits
- [FertilityWindowPolicy](../apps/android/app/src/main/java/de/lunara/app/data/prediction/FertilityWindowPolicy.kt#L11) — Shared native calendar, current-summary and notification safety
- [isSupportedFertileWindow](../services/api/src/prediction/fertility-policy.ts#L5) — Reject invalid or wider-than-current-model legacy envelopes, never clip them
